decision: Treat qualified extended-license demand as the critical path. Do not count planned prices, a live listing, or checkout reachability as revenue.
success_condition: At least JPY 200,000 of verified rolling-30-day non-labor seller proceeds; the conservative direct-price proxy is five USD 349 extended-license sales.
withdrawal_condition: If the live offer receives a full bounded qualified-traffic effect window with no checkout starts or qualified inquiries, change audience, channel, or offer rather than continuing same-layer copy edits.
effect_window: Starts only after the offer, automatic delivery, public acquisition route, and event measurement are all externally verified live; evaluate after 30 days or 100 qualified product visits, whichever is later.
largest_uncertainty: Qualified buyer traffic and willingness to pay for the extended license; prices and fee arithmetic are not demand evidence.
next_trigger: Recalculate on price or fee change; begin the demand effect window only after live-offer and measurement read-back.
